dialogues.jp:
瞬殺されたＨＲで空いた時間を無効活用して、
校舎内をぶらつく。
dialogues.en:
I was wandering around the school after our teacher let us
go early from homeroom.
dialogues.text:
I was wandering around the school after our teacher let us
go early from homeroom.

dialogues.jp:
商店街をぶらつくだとか、お家で昼寝だとか、
もっと時間を有効活用する選択はできなかった
のかと、自分に問いたい。
dialogues.en:
I could've used my time more effectively, by wandering
around the city or taking a nap at home......
dialogues.text:
I could've used my time more effectively, by wandering
around the city or taking a nap at home......

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……なぜ俺は見飽きた学園をさまよって
　いるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh...... Why am I wandering around this boring school?"
dialogues.text: "Huh...... Why am I wandering around this boring school?"

dialogues.jp: 遠い目をして、窓の外に視線を向ける。
dialogues.en: I stared out of the window.
dialogues.text: I stared out of the window.

dialogues.jp:
結構、早いほうだと思っていたが、上には上が
いるものだ。校門に向かって歩いていく学生の
姿が見える。
dialogues.en:
I thought my teacher let us go early, but some students were
already heading out of the gate.
dialogues.text:
I thought my teacher let us go early, but some students were
already heading out of the gate.

dialogues.jp:
あの暦先生の短時間ＨＲを上回る｛やつ／講師｝が、いる
とでも言うのか？
dialogues.en:
Is there another teacher who dismisses there students
earlier than Koyomi-sensei?
dialogues.text:
Is there another teacher who dismisses there students
earlier than Koyomi-sensei?

dialogues.jp: 「ぜひ、担任にお迎えしたい」
dialogues.en: "I'd love to have that teacher as my homeroom teacher."
dialogues.text: "I'd love to have that teacher as my homeroom teacher."

dialogues.jp:
学内をぶらつくって言っても、他の教室をのぞ
いてもしょうがないし……なんとなく暇を潰せ
る購買に足が向かう。
dialogues.en:
I decided to go to the school store, since I had nowhere
else interesting to go to.
dialogues.text:
I decided to go to the school store, since I had nowhere
else interesting to go to.

dialogues.jp:
「せっかくだから、シャーペンの芯でも買って
　いくか」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'll buy some lead for my mechanical pencil."
dialogues.text: "I guess I'll buy some lead for my mechanical pencil."

dialogues.jp:
急ぎでもないけど、せっかく近くまで来たんだ
し、たくさん持っていて困るものでもなかろう。
dialogues.en:
It isn't a necessity, but since I'm here I might as well buy
a few extras.
dialogues.text:
It isn't a necessity, but since I'm here I might as well buy
a few extras.

dialogues.jp: 購買に足を踏み入れ、文房具の棚を目指す。
dialogues.en:
I stepped inside of the store and walked toward the
stationery area.
dialogues.text:
I stepped inside of the store and walked toward the
stationery area.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、よほど暇だな俺も」
dialogues.en: "I'm so bored."
dialogues.text: "I'm so bored."

dialogues.jp:
シャーペンの芯を買って、再び廊下に出て、た
め息をつく。
dialogues.en: I sighed in the hallway after buying the lead.
dialogues.text: I sighed in the hallway after buying the lead.

dialogues.jp: こんなんはコンビニでも売っているというに。
dialogues.en: I could've bought this at the convenience store.
dialogues.text: I could've bought this at the convenience store.

dialogues.jp: 「さって、本気で帰る――」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'm going home......"
dialogues.text: "I guess I'm going home......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ほえ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
昇降口に向かって足を踏み出した格好のまま、
購買の入口を振り返る。
dialogues.en:
As I took my first step toward the exit, I looked back
toward the store.
dialogues.text:
As I took my first step toward the exit, I looked back
toward the store.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.jp:
学園で売られる本となると、ジャンルが限られ
てくるのだが。
dialogues.en: "Oh, hi. Were you shopping in there too, Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, hi. Were you shopping in there too, Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「『夢分析辞典』です」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I was here to buy a book."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I was here to buy a book."

dialogues.jp: なんか、変わったものを買うんだな。
「いや、萌先輩らしいか……」
dialogues.en: (A manga...... no, I guess not.)
dialogues.text: (A manga...... no, I guess not.)

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・／いつも｝夢の中だもんな……。
dialogues.en:
They only have a limited range of books inside of the school
store.
dialogues.text:
They only have a limited range of books inside of the school
store.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩って夢に興味があるんだ」
dialogues.en: "What book did you get?"
dialogues.text: "What book did you get?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "I got a 'Dream Analysis Dictionary'."
dialogues.text: "I got a 'Dream Analysis Dictionary'."

dialogues.jp:
聞き間違いか……もしくは、夢の中で気になる
場所があるのだろう。
dialogues.en: "Dream analysis?"
dialogues.text: "Dream analysis?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。朝倉くんもですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の快諾を得て、俺は促すように歩き始め
る。
dialogues.en: She has a weird taste.
dialogues.text: She has a weird taste.

dialogues.jp:
廊下を並んで歩きながら二言、三言、会話を交
わしたとき――。
dialogues.en: "It sounds like your kind of book, Moe-sempai......"
dialogues.text: "It sounds like your kind of book, Moe-sempai......"

dialogues.jp:
後ろから眞子の声が聞こえ、俺と萌先輩が振り
返る。
dialogues.en: After all, she's always in a 'Dream World'.
dialogues.text: After all, she's always in a 'Dream World'.

dialogues.jp:
眞子が膨れっ面で近づいてくる。何なんだ、いっ
たい。
dialogues.en: "So you're interested in dreams?"
dialogues.text: "So you're interested in dreams?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ああー、そうでしたね」
dialogues.en: "They are...... a precious place for me......"
dialogues.text: "They are...... a precious place for me......"

dialogues.jp:
眞子が、ガックリと肩を落とし、うなだれる。
さすがにもう怒る気力も失せたらしい。
dialogues.en: "A precious place?"
dialogues.text: "A precious place?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ちょっと同情した。
dialogues.en:
Did I hear her wrong......? Maybe she dreamed about places
in her dream.
dialogues.text:
Did I hear her wrong......? Maybe she dreamed about places
in her dream.

dialogues.jp: 眞子の視線が、ジロリとこっちに向く。
dialogues.en:
I can't really ask in detail. I shouldn't stick my neck into
someone else's private matters.
dialogues.text:
I can't really ask in detail. I shouldn't stick my neck into
someone else's private matters.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく暇をつぶすために来た、などと言う
わけにはいかない。
dialogues.en: "Are you leaving now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you leaving now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんは、しっかりしてるんですねえ」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Are you leaving too?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Are you leaving too?"

dialogues.jp:
｛ひょうたん／瓢箪｝から｛こま／駒｝というか、意外なところで萌先輩に
好印象を与えたようだ。
dialogues.en: "Yes. Why don't we walk back home together?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Why don't we walk back home together?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、朝倉くんも一緒に帰りませんか？　
　みんなで帰ったら、きっと楽しいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が、ぽんと手を叩いて提案する。
dialogues.en: I started walking after she accepted my suggestion.
dialogues.text: I started walking after she accepted my suggestion.

dialogues.jp:
俺は考えるまでもなかった。独りでトボトボと
帰るぐらいなら、両手に花のほうがずっといい。
dialogues.en: After we spoke a few words in the hallway......,
dialogues.text: After we spoke a few words in the hallway......,

dialogues.jp: 「いいですよ。ちょうど帰ろうと思ってたんで」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いいでしょ、眞子ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Zzz."
dialogues.text: "Zzz."

dialogues.jp: 年長者らしく萌先輩が先陣をきって歩き始める。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai fell asleep.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai fell asleep.

dialogues.jp: ◆夢分析辞典◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dream analysis dictionary◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dream analysis dictionary◆

dialogues.jp: 購買で萌先輩と出会い一緒に帰る。
dialogues.en:
I met Moe-sempai at the school store and we decided to go
home together.
dialogues.text:
I met Moe-sempai at the school store and we decided to go
home together.

dialogues.jp:
先輩は『夢分析辞典』なるものを買ったらしい。
まあ、いつも夢の中にいるようなもんだもんな。
dialogues.en:
She bought a book called 'Dream analysis dictionary'. After
all, she always seems to be dreaming.
dialogues.text:
She bought a book called 'Dream analysis dictionary'. After
all, she always seems to be dreaming.

dialogues.jp:
その後、萌先輩は二言三言しゃべってからお休
みになられた。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai spoke a few words and then fell asleep.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai spoke a few words and then fell asleep.
